detail: BigEndian Semiconductors Private Limited has raised $6 million through a Pre-Series A CCPS fundraise led by IAN Alpha Fund, with participation from Vertex Ventures SEA and India, IvyCap Ventures and angel investors. Fox Mandal & Associates advised BigEndian Semiconductors on this fundraise. The Firm rendered comprehensive legal support throughout the transaction, including advising on the transaction structure; drafting, reviewing, and negotiating the definitive transaction documents; facilitating their execution; and assisting with the satisfaction of closing conditions and other ancillary matters to ensure the successful completion of the transaction.
